snippet.title: WE ARE SO COOKED - Trailer
snippet.description:
In this cozy cooking game set in a witch’s kitchen, collect ingredients while chatting with other players, fill the giant cauldron, and complete magical recipes. Social interactions and light chaos blend with a calm, relaxing gameplay pace.

#wearesocooked #mergenstudios
